notes.title: The Final Stretch to Early Access Launch!
notes.content: We are in the final development push as we prepare for our Early Access launch. We are about 2 weeks from release as of this announcement (March 4th). We've made some environmental changes based on feedback to improve the gameplay look and feel. Millions of bugs have been slaughtered in the pursuit of  release readiness. We want to make sure that we can get as much content in and verified ready for launch, and of course we'll be constantly adding and updating things throughout Early Access.
